whenToUse: An agency delivery portfolio: budget burn against work done for every project.
Updating project health, milestones and risks from a side sheet without leaving the overview.
avoidWhen: One project in depth — use detail-10.
Task-level scheduling with dependencies — use gantt.
a11y: Burn map and runway are role="img" with labels; sections are named by their headings.
Do not convey health by colour alone; keep the text status beside each dot.
